answer: Shared Entropy Ledger. Each agent identity must embed a unique random seed whose outputs are published to a public log; any two seeds producing correlated streams become detectable. A mirror of the log lets peers cross-check overlap. Every duplicate forks a visible seam like a vine splitting, flagged on the mesa of records. Attackers pay a fresh hardware entropy source and continuous proof generation per identity, so mass duplication costs linear compute and storage.
